title: Feedback moves the pole from +2 to −3
caption: Without control ẋ = 2x grows like e^{2t}. With u = −5x the closed loop is ẋ = −3x and x(t) = e^{−3t} decays with time constant 1/3 s.
alt: From x(0) = 1, one curve grows rapidly (open loop e^{2t}) and one decays (closed loop e^{−3t}); the decaying one is at 0.368 at t = 1/3.
description: Open loop: ẋ = 2x, pole at +2, so x = e^{2t} grows.
Choose u = −Kx: ẋ = (2 − K)x, and 2 − K = −3 needs K = 5.
Closed loop x = e^{−3t}: it reaches 1/e ≈ 0.368 at t = 1/3 s.

checks.name: after τ = 1/3 the value is e⁻¹
